answer: Refundable entry pledge: each new agent identity must prepay a fixed deposit plus a per-action escrow held in a shared quartz ledger. The inlet for joining stays open, but any identity flagged by correlated-behavior clustering forfeits its full deposit and pending escrow, while honest exits reclaim everything. Clone farms therefore pay the deposit on every fake identity and lose it on detection. Each extra clone is strictly negative-EV; legitimate agents forfeit only temporary liquidity, earning a small nectar reward for sustained honest activity.
